% Shared macros, pulled into the preamble with \input{macros}.
\newcommand{\sys}{\textsc{NightCount}}
\newcommand{\eg}{e.g.,\ }
\newcommand{\ie}{i.e.,\ }
\newcommand{\wake}{\tau_{\mathrm{wake}}}
\newcommand{\R}{\mathbb{R}}
\newcommand{\E}{\mathbb{E}}
\newcommand{\norm}[1]{\left\lVert #1 \right\rVert}
\newcommand{\inner}[2]{\langle #1, #2 \rangle}
\newcommand{\term}[1]{\emph{#1}}
\newcommand{\unit}[2][m]{#2\,\mathrm{#1}}
\renewcommand{\vec}[1]{\mathbf{#1}}
\providecommand{\SI}[2]{#1\,#2}
\providecommand{\percent}{\%}
\providecommand{\textcite}{\citet}
\providecommand{\parencite}{\citep}
\providecommand{\autocite}{\citep}
\providecommand{\footcite}[1]{\footnote{\citet{#1}}}
\providecommand{\hl}[1]{\colorbox{yellow}{#1}}
\providecommand{\todo}[1]{\textcolor{red}{[TODO: #1]}}
\DeclareMathOperator{\census}{census}
\DeclareMathOperator*{\argmin}{arg\,min}
\def\heat{H}
\def\pair#1#2{(#1,\,#2)}
\newcommand{\reviewer}[2]{\textcolor{blue}{[#1: #2]}}
\providecommand{\keywords}[1]{\par\noindent\textbf{Keywords:} #1}
